summary: Loma Negra Compania Industrial Argentina Sociedad Anonima filed a Form 6-K on April 24, 2026, reporting resolutions approved at its Ordinary Shareholders Meeting held on April 23, 2026. The meeting approved the allocation of accumulated results (AR$23,584,613 thousand) to an Optional Reserve for Future Dividends and delegated to the Board the power to distribute cash dividends at their discretion, subject to business evolution and regulatory limits, until the next annual meeting. No M&A, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special situation was involved.
